The Christmas Inn [Book Review] #ThrowbackThursday #BookX #BookSky #bookblogger #UpLit

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:08
Instaread

Escape to The Christmas Inn in Cape Cod, New England for comfort food, delicious cookies, a crackling fire, sides of slow-burn romance, and multi-generational friendship.

The Christmas Inn by Pamela Kelley

Genre/Categories/Setting: Contemporary Women’s Fiction, Multigenerational Friendship, Slow-burn Romance, Women Supporting Women, Women-owned Business, Cape Cod (New England)

***This post contains Amazon affiliate links

Welcome to #ThrowBackThursday where I highlight an older review or post a current review of a backlist title. Today I’m sharing a cozy uplit winter read, The Christmas Inn by Pamela Kelley.

I’m linking up with Davida @ The Chocolate Lady’s Book Review Blog for #ThrowbackThursday.

Summary of The Christmas Inn:

In this cozy story, Riley has just lost her job as a content marketing manager right before Christmas. She decides to go to the Inn to help her mom who has just broken her leg. The help she offers and the Christmas rush is just the distraction she needs. And yes,…her (recently widowed) high school sweetheart is also a distraction! Christmas truly is the most magical time of the year!

A cozy winter read…
